0022600142.text: The Dallas Mavericks (2-2, 0-1 at home, 8th in the West) host the Oklahoma City Thunder (4-0, 1st in the West), who are on a four-game winning streak, while Dallas is on a W1 streak. Dallas is without Caleb Martin, Dereck Lively II, Santi Aldama, and Tarik Biberovic, and Naji Marshall (illness) and Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace, Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Nikola Topic, Otega Oweh, and Thomas Sorber, with Alex Caruso (ankle) day-to-day and a game-time decision; the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Mavericks lost 0-3 to them in 2025-26, most recently 100-87 in Dallas on March 1, 2026.
